known_text: He wanted you to tell me yesterday.

use.known: He wanted you to help me with the work yesterday.
use.target: 他昨天想让你帮我做工作。

use.known: That young woman asked if he can come to help tomorrow.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人问他是不是明天能来帮忙。

use.known: If he has time tonight, he will help us with the work.
use.target: 如果他今天晚上有时间的话，他会帮我们做工作。

use.known: I want him to tell us what the old woman said.
use.target: 我想他告诉我们那个老女人说了什么。

use.known: Everyone is waiting for him to give us an answer.
use.target: 大家都在等他给我们一个答案。

use.known: Would he be able to remember what happened last night?
use.target: 他能记住昨天晚上发生了什么吗？

use.known: He wanted you to come yesterday but you were busy.
use.target: 他昨天想让你来但是你忙。

use.known: That young man asked what happened yesterday.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人问昨天发生了什么。

use.known: If you saw your sister yesterday, please tell us now.
use.target: 如果你昨天见了你姐姐的话，请现在告诉我们。

use.known: She just told me she met that old man yesterday.
use.target: 她刚告诉我她昨天见了那个老人。

use.known: Everyone here remembers what happened yesterday.
use.target: 这里的大家都记住昨天发生了什么。

use.known: Did your brother tell you what he did yesterday?
use.target: 你哥哥告诉你他昨天做了什么吗？

use.known: He wanted you to tell me what happened at work.
use.target: 他想让你告诉我工作发生了什么。

use.known: That young woman wanted to know what happened yesterday.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人想知道昨天发生了什么。

use.known: If she wanted to help, she would have said something.
use.target: 如果她想帮忙的话，她会说东西。

use.known: Your brother wanted to meet your sister last night.
use.target: 你哥哥昨天晚上想见你姐姐。

use.known: Everyone here wanted to know when the meeting starts.
use.target: 这里的大家都想知道开会什么时候开始。

use.known: What did that old man want to tell you about?
use.target: 那个老人想告诉你什么？

use.known: He wanted you to tell me what happened yesterday.
use.target: 他想让你告诉我昨天发生了什么。

use.known: That young woman asked me to let her know tomorrow.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人问我让她明天知道。

use.known: If you need help, please let us know right away.
use.target: 如果你需要帮忙的话，请让我们知道。

use.known: She let him know what happened at the meeting.
use.target: 她让他知道开会发生了什么。

use.known: Everyone here let me know they want to help.
use.target: 这里的大家都让我知道他们想帮忙。

use.known: Would you let me tell you what the old man said?
use.target: 你让我告诉你那个老人说了什么吗？

use.known: He wanted you to tell me before the meeting started.
use.target: 他想让你开会开始以前告诉我。

use.known: That old man told me he wants to see you tomorrow.
use.target: 那个老人告诉我他想明天见你。

use.known: If she can help you, I think you should ask her now.
use.target: 如果她能帮你的话，我觉得你现在要问她。

use.known: She hopes you can tell her what happened yesterday.
use.target: 她希望你能告诉她昨天发生了什么。

use.known: Everyone here wants to know what you think about this.
use.target: 这里的大家都想知道你觉得这个怎么样。

use.known: Would that young man be able to work together with you?
use.target: 那个年轻的男人能和你一起工作吗？

use.known: He wanted you to tell me about the meeting yesterday.
use.target: 他昨天想让你告诉我开会的东西。

use.known: That old woman said she wanted to tell us the answer.
use.target: 那个老女人说她想告诉我们答案。

use.known: If you want to tell him something, do it before he goes.
use.target: 如果你想告诉他东西的话，他走以前做。

use.known: She told us what happened when she met your brother.
use.target: 她告诉我们她见你哥哥的时候发生了什么。

use.known: Everyone wants to tell you we appreciate your help.
use.target: 大家都想告诉你我们很感激你的帮忙。

use.known: Who told you about what happened at work yesterday?
use.target: 谁告诉你昨天工作发生了什么？

use.known: He wanted you to tell me what happened yesterday.
use.target: 他想让你告诉我昨天发生了什么。

use.known: That young man asked me if I know your brother.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人问我是不是认识你哥哥。

use.known: If the old woman can tell me, I would be very happy.
use.target: 如果那个老女人能告诉我的话，我会很开心。

use.known: Everyone told me they want to meet your sister too.
use.target: 大家都告诉我他们也想见你姐姐。

use.known: Would that young woman be able to help me with this?
use.target: 那个年轻的女人能帮我做这个吗？

use.known: She hopes I can remember what the old man said.
use.target: 她希望我能记住那个老人说了什么。
